label: western
name: Western controls
description: Swaps Circle and Cross, and Triangle and Square and vice-versa. Like a western PlayStation game.

label: saves
name: Save menu
description: Merges the slot 1 and slot 2 menus into one, so that you don't have to worry about which one to select. Requires "speed up on memory card access" to not feel like a slog.

label: mark
name: Black Mark
description: Makes Masao Inaba black. It uses a custom sprite I made for him so that he's both black and still wears his original outfit. Doesn't change the script.

label: battlespeed
name: Battle speedup
description: Doubles the speed of summons and skill effects in battle.

label: 60fps
name: 60 FPS
description: Interpolates frames to get the dungeons to 60fps and the map to 30fps. Only does it when you're actively moving around. Needs overclocking (to like 190-200% to be completely smooth).

label: rewards
name: Double rewards
description: Doubles the EXP, Persona points and money you get after battles. Like everything else in this section, this is an option. In this case, if you want an easier game. This is not the intended original experience of the game!

label: encounters
name: Halve encounters
description: Halves the rate of random encounters. Like everything else in this section, this is an option. In this case, if you want an easier game. This is not the intended original experience of the game!

label: run
name: Run in dungeons
description: Hold Cross to run in dungeons.

label: upright
name: Upper-right movement
description: Up now moves to the upper right instead of the upper left.

label: skipfmv
name: Skip movies
description: Press Start to skip the currently playing movie.
